selection: Depth-only comparison: reuse the three trained 4-layer circular baseline runs; train 8 and 12 encoder layers from random initialization using seeds 42/43/44. Keep width 96, normalization floor 0.02, tokenizer, head, loss and training schedule unchanged. Replacement requires >=1% lower mean joint-mirror validation MSE; mean length MSE may increase at most 2%, dX MAE 5%, dY MAE 2%. Choose minimum eligible validation MSE or keep 4 layers; deploy the median-validation seed. Freeze before test.
test_policy: Only the baseline and validation-frozen winner are evaluated on the same previously inspected 100 test IDs, each with three seeds. This is repeated evaluation, not a new blind test. Do not select a different depth or seed from test results. Sample 207 remains the fixed inference illustration.
quality_scope: Corrected generator2 2.2.0 top-metal 1000: thick SiO2 into lower PML / passive JC Au 100 nm / As2Se3 tetramer. Metal-only 8 nm, pipeline_validation. Inverse-model depth study; no forward network, data regeneration or new FDTD run.
